items.title: 7.5 Computing's Impact on Individuals and Society (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computing's impact (PDF 186).

blocks.text: Computing systems ne hamare jeene, kaam karne aur baat cheet ke andaaz badal diye hain. Internet, smartphones aur artificial intelligence ke phailao ke musbat aur manfi dono asraat hain.

blocks.prompt: Computing ka ek musbat aur ek manfi asar bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Musbat: maloomat aur taleem tak aasan rasai. Manfi: ghalat maloomat ka tezi se phailna.

items: Computing afraad aur muashre ko faide aur nuqsan dono deti hai.
